title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. i am sameer deshmukh from gwalior,my matter is that there is a mosque in my neighbour where i offer namaz going regularly to masque i found that waqf commitie members has given permission to a non muslim to do all kind of work like wise collecting rent from shops of masque,giving sallary to imaam,cleaning water tank and other important work like mantaining all expenses records.but when i questioned to the waqf commitie they said there is no harm.and when i asked for expense statement they said you have no right to see the records we will show it to state waqf board and to allah only.please guid me from quran and hadit that such work of masjid be done by a non muslim or muslim ,and can a person see expense record of waqf commitie. 1983 views Q. Is it permissible to put up a residence on the open terrace of a masjid.The masjid is on the ground and first floor and the donor who has built this masjid in a school compound wants to stay here whenever he comes home from abroad,so that he can monitor the school activities.He visits once in six months and stays for a few days only. 1839 views Q. We would like to ask a Shari Ruling regarding rent for a Madrasah which is based at an Islamic Secondary school building, the Islamic Secondary school building was opened by the current Chairman and the current Vice Chairman (a committee was later made on the bases that they would be supportive). Currently the Madrasah uses three classes in the evening for Madrasah. The Madrasah currently pay?s rent. But the issue has arisen about rent for the Madrasah when it first opened in 2004. Before the Madrasah opened, eminent scholars gave Mushwerah that the building was not used in the evenings and it would be suitable for evening Madrasah, through this it was then decided by the Chairman that the building can be used without any rent being paid, this was due to the Madrasah being new and to get the Madrasah running, at this time none of the Governors of the school were active in the daily issues of the school. From 2006 due to some issues (regarding the Islamic Secondary school) the Governors of the school got involved and they raised the issue of rent and they decided that rent should be back dated to (2004) and paid to the date of when payment first started (which was 2006). According to Shariah is it compulsory to for the Madrasah to pay the backdated rent? 1763 views Q. Construting Mosque ove septic tank 1782 views Q. AssalamAlaikum Respected Mufti Saab, Since the construction of our masjid ten years ago, the qibla was assumed to be exactly eastwards i.e 90 degrees clockwise. (using a standard 360 degree rotation) Using more accurate and reliable calculations, we have calculated the qibla again and it is in fact 66.52 degrees clockwise. It means therefore that our present qibla direction is off by approximately 23.48 degrees to the actual qibla. Is this amount of variation allowed? What should we do henceforth? An urgant reply will be most appreciated as this issue is of utmost importance to our entire community. JazakAllah. 3077 views Q. Salah 1287 views Q. ASSALAAMU A'LAIKUM,HAJRAT,after my fathers death, i got a piece of land on which,a portion of land I have made WAQF for MASJID. But there are more 2 MOSJIDS nearly that area. So, the villagers are not allowing for ONE MORE MOSJID. Then, what can i do with that portion of land? JAZAA KUMULLAAHU KHAIRAN. 1697 views Q. Reconstruction of mosque with parking basement 7056 views Q. I am a local musalli of a masjid in my area and would like to have the following clarifed. We had an imam appointed at our masjid who as part of his salary was given the liberty of staying in a property that the masjid owns, with his family at no charge. the issue now is that the imam has left his employment. However as the property is owned by the masjid and was to be used only for imams, due to him no longer being employed as the masjid's imam, it was part of his contract that he vacate the premises on leaving his post. the individual in question has refused to do so and on trying to reach an amicable agreement with him, the masjid committee stated that they would allow him and his family to continue living in the property owned by the masjid if he provided a reasonable rental sum every month. to this also the imam refused and at present has been living in the property rent free for a few months. 1. please could you let us know what the ruling is for such a person (imam) in light of the Qur'an and Sunnah. 2. What would the best course of action be to resolve this dilema? 3. Many local scholars and learned people who are aware of this situation have stated through reference to religious texts (I cannot remember exactly which ones as I am not myself a scholar) that the leading of salah by such an individual described above is makhrooh tehreemi. Is this correct? 2921 views Q. Use of Muslim graveyard land and goverment fund 2603 views Q. Kya kahte hain Ulma-e-Kiram is baare mein --- 1. Kya Masjid me 'Waaz' ka intizaam kiya ja sakta hai ? 2.Agar Masjid mein 'Waaz' ka intizaam kiya ja sakta hai, to kya wahan 'Ladies' ko bhi sunne ke liye daawat di jaa sakti hai jabki parde ka pura intizaam ho? 1921 views Q. My question is "IN MY COLLEGE MOSQUE IF WE MISSED THE MAIN JAMAAT OF ZOHAR, WE WANT TO MAKE ANOTHER JAMAAT."WILL WE HAVE TO SAY THE IQAMAT AGAIN OR START THE NAMAZ WITHOUT SAYING IQAMAT AGAIN. Please clarify because more than one jamaats are made in the mosque 2179 views Q. Demolition of Mosque completely to ground level for the new construction 4356 views Q. Sunnat of entering in Masjid 2615 views Q. shifting of masjid shelves to the residence of imam e masjid 1656 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 37027 Country: India Title: helping my community Question: I am a highly educated boy, but whenever I see a madrasa I feel very emotional I get a feeling of helping them. I want to teach my cute little brothers and sisters. Please guide me I live in Mumbai. Please give any contact so that I can serve my community to the most, where I can teach. I live in Bandra, Mahim area. Answer ID: 37027 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 287/226/B=1433) Your interest of serving the madrasa is appreciable and worthy of congratulation. May Almighty Allah give you firmness in such interests! Get any employment as per your status and keep on doing the service of madrasas and mosques. May you progress and prosper! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
